otherNightReminder: Remove any *No Ability* Reminder token. Put the *No Ability* Reminder on any Townsfolk with any *Trade* Reminder token on them.
name: Solicitor
ability: 2 living players may publicly choose to trade all potions once per day. If either player is dead when the trade would happen, no trade occurs and no player loses their ability.
flavor: Oh, I love the Festival! It's my busiest workday of the year!
